name.description: Basename for the generated files (kebab-case, e.g. incidents-report).

project.description: Nx project to generate into — files land under its sourceRoot.

directory.description: Output dir (workspace-root-relative) — overrides the project-derived default.

framework.description: Framework override — detection reads the project's package.json otherwise.

variant.description: Kind variant — island: facade|mono · route: task|client.

memory.description: Shared-memory contract name to wire into a generated worker.
